His current assignment is the Senator from Ord Mantell.|An individual speaking on the assassin's assignment|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
An '''individual''' served as the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Cynerus]], one of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] top [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], was tasked with [[Death/Legends|killing]] the senator, but was intercepted by an [[HK-51]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]].
